Nolan / From the table

Stories and episode companions.

I play tournament poker and am building a vlog. Published accounts will live here, separate from the resource directory and fictional teaching exercises.

A starting point

Review a hand, not just the result.

A worked, clearly fictional hand shows how to keep the action, original thinking, and later analysis separate.

No vlog episodes or tournament stories are published on this site yet. This guide and the study resources below are available now.

Try a decision

Scope / Trust / Contact

Useful context, not a promise of certainty.

The directory is growing, not complete. See what it covers and what is still missing. Outside sources carry access labels, review dates and limitations. Fictional exercises and personal accounts stay clearly separated.

Read the resource review policy or inspect the recorded review methods and dates. Gambling-support resources are always available without searching.

What is missing or unclear?

Send a question, correction or resource suggestion. Include the page or topic, but leave other players' private information out. Follow the Poker RSS feed for new published pages.
